title: Symbiosis & Parasitism
description: Two populations that share a world either compete, prey, or help. A parasite and a symbiont can be the same organism with one interaction coefficient flipped; mitochondria were invaders once. The boundary between anomaly and normality is a sign. Unlocks the Symbiont Culture.

puzzle.goal: Two populations N₁ and N₂ share a world. Each grows logistically at rate r_i up to its own capacity K_i, and each member of the second population counts as α members of the first against that capacity; α > 0 is competition, α < 0 is help. Write how the first population changes.
puzzle.name: competitive Lotka–Volterra equations (and mutualism)
puzzle.ask: The second population has the mirror equation with coefficient β. They coexist at N₁* = (K₁ − αK₂)/(1 − αβ). With K₁ = K and K₂ = L, find N₁*.
puzzle.method: Logistic growth r N(1 − N/K) with the other population added to the crowding term. For the equilibrium set both brackets to zero and solve the pair.
